_readme: Sessions from schedule.md. Times are local venue time (Pacific), 24-hour HH:MM. Each session's room must be listed in rooms so walk hints know its building. Notes are short summaries of the session descriptions. Check edits with: python3 tools/validate_schedule.py

sessions.title: Universe Badge Pickup Party!
sessions.speaker: Special event
sessions.note: Pick up your badge early and skip the line: snacks, drinks and exclusive Universe merch.

sessions.title: Opening Keynote
sessions.speaker: Jay Parikh (Microsoft), Cassidy Williams (GitHub), Burke Holland (Microsoft), April Leonard (GitHub), Damian Brady (GitHub)
sessions.note: New announcements, live demos and a few surprises.

sessions.title: Shut the context window! You're letting the tokens out
sessions.speaker: Dylan McCarthy (Nexwave)
sessions.note: How Copilot builds context, the habits that bloat tokens, and guardrails that catch overly broad changes.

sessions.title: Building AI fluency at UPS
sessions.speaker: Jared Hatfield (UPS)
sessions.note: Moving developers from trying Copilot to fluency with agents, at enterprise scale.

sessions.title: The Low Orbit Agentic Cannon: Scaling Copilot through internal tooling
sessions.speaker: Callum Cieciala (Galaxy)
sessions.note: 300+ agent PRs in one morning: the tooling that scaled Copilot agents across hundreds of repos.

sessions.title: Build once, run on any agent: a practical guide to agent skills
sessions.speaker: Andrea Griffiths (GitHub), Shishir Tewari (Procore Technologies)
sessions.note: Reusable skill files any coding agent can run, from personal use to a team's production pipeline.

sessions.title: Agent-driven deployment beyond localhost, shared securely with your team (Sponsored)
sessions.note: Demo: an agent opens a PR, deploys your app and puts it behind private, identity-based access for your team.

sessions.title: Turning user feedback into requirements with a custom copilot agent
sessions.speaker: Kristin N. Dew (GitHub), Catharine McNally (GitHub)
sessions.note: GitHub App demo: an agent that joins feedback from many channels into one view to shape requirements.

sessions.title: Rediscover the command line: Practical workflows with GitHub CLI
sessions.speaker: Ryan Hecht (GitHub), Ayman Bagabas (GitHub)
sessions.note: From Unix pipes and shell scripts up to real workflows with GitHub CLI, Git, Gum and Copilot CLI.

sessions.title: CSU Team Dinner
sessions.speaker: CSU GitHub Universe Crew
sessions.note: Location TBD. Add the room here once it's set.

sessions.title: The view from the labs: What's next for AI-assisted development
sessions.speaker: Rohan Varma (OpenAI), April Leonard (GitHub), Richard Seroter (Google Cloud), Angela Jiang (Anthropic)
sessions.note: Panel with the frontier model labs on what the next two years of AI-assisted development look like.

sessions.title: How to turn your team's repeated workflows into GitHub Copilot CLI skills
sessions.speaker: Bea Mendez Gandica (Nuevo Foundation), Jeremiah Isaacson (Nuevo Foundation)
sessions.note: In the Founders Inc. space. Hands-on: package a workflow your team repeats into a Copilot CLI skill, built from scratch.

sessions.title: 17 agents, one SDLC: How Levi Strauss reimagined development on GitHub
sessions.speaker: Jenny Patchen (Levi Strauss & Co.)
sessions.note: 17 specialized agents across the SDLC; every PR is reviewed by 5 to 11 agents, with human approval gates.

sessions.title: Watch the Keynote from Cowell Theater
sessions.speaker: Special event
sessions.note: The keynote streamed live in a quieter room with comfortable seats and a good view of the screen.
